info.name: Get Stream Likes - All Test Cases
info.description: Comprehensive test cases for getStreamLikes endpoint with all filter combinations

testCases.name: Case 1: StreamId only - All likes in stream
testCases.description: Get all likes from all posts across all chapters and pages in the stream

testCases.name: Case 2: SocialPageId only (alias for StreamId)
testCases.description: Same as StreamId, using SocialPageId parameter

testCases.name: Case 3: PageId only - All likes in a page
testCases.description: Get all likes from all posts in a specific page

testCases.name: Case 4: PostId only - All versions of a post
testCases.description: Get all likes for a specific post across all hexcode versions

testCases.name: Case 5: SocialPostId only (alias for PostId)
testCases.description: Same as PostId, using SocialPostId parameter

testCases.name: Case 6: hexcode only - Specific version across all posts
testCases.description: Get all likes for a specific hexcode version across all posts

testCases.name: Case 7: hexcode_blendedImage only (alias for hexcode)
testCases.description: Same as hexcode, using hexcode_blendedImage parameter

testCases.name: Case 8: StreamId + PageId - Page likes within stream
testCases.description: Get likes for all posts in a page, filtered by stream (double validation)

testCases.name: Case 9: StreamId + PostId - Post likes within stream
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post, filtered by stream

testCases.name: Case 10: StreamId + hexcode - Version likes within stream
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific hexcode version, filtered by stream

testCases.name: Case 11: PageId + PostId - Post likes within page
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post, filtered by page (Note: PostId takes priority)

testCases.name: Case 12: PageId + hexcode - Version likes within page
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific hexcode version in all posts of that page

testCases.name: Case 13: PostId + hexcode - Specific post version
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post with a specific hexcode version (MOST SPECIFIC)

testCases.name: Case 14: StreamId + PageId + PostId
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post, filtered by both stream and page (PostId takes priority)

testCases.name: Case 15: StreamId + PageId + hexcode
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific hexcode version in all posts of a page within a stream

testCases.name: Case 16: StreamId + PostId + hexcode
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post version within a stream (MOST SPECIFIC + stream filter)

testCases.name: Case 17: PageId + PostId + hexcode
testCases.description: Get likes for a specific post version, filtered by page (hexcode + PostId take priority)

testCases.name: Case 18: ALL FILTERS - Maximum specificity
testCases.description: Get likes with all filters applied - maximum specificity with stream validation

testCases.name: Case 19: Empty body - Should fail
testCases.description: Should return error: 'Please provide at least one filter'

testCases.name: Case 20: Invalid StreamId format
testCases.description: Should handle invalid ObjectId format gracefully

notes.priority: Filter priority: hexcode > PostId > PageId > StreamId
notes.important: Remember to replace example IDs with actual IDs from your database
